subject: general
question: In a certain code language, "CLOCK" is written as "BKUBJ" and "WATCH" is written as "VESBG". How will "TIME" be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b572428d7e2d61f958ce42f97ff10e9a3d419a0d932a066d5365d2ce1f26513.png] 

The logic followed here is as follows:

 
• **Vowels are coded as next vowels as they appear in the series.**

A → E → I → O → U

 
• **Consonants are coded as previous consonants as they appear in the series.**

Given:

**​**"CLOCK" is written as "BKUBJ"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2ca724adf3bdfa0896553ae3e6e0e907aed7e44c0a61ad07ba9f927c76bcf48.png] 

And

"WATCH" is written as "VESBG"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce76dfd914ea4e025f889126fae58f988dc04986cc19a2582ce9cdc42bc3e9c2.png] 

Similarly,

"TIME" be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2cf85d678d983153e99cbc2206aefcbbd0b4f6521e1aaf43f6f9e6b3e2725ca.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SOLI"**
